pages.title: https://www.shellcampground.com/deposit-cancellation-fees/ | Deposits, Cancellation Fees and Policies – Shell Campground
pages.lines:
CANCELLATION FEES:
Greater than 14 days from first night stay: $25 cancellation fee per each accommodation.
14 days or less from first night stay: Guest is responsible for 100% of balance due.
Special cancellation fees for HUNTING SEASON (stays during September through November)
– Cancellation received within 2 weeks of draw results: $25 per accommodation
– Cancellation received after 2 weeks of draw results: Guest is responsible for 100% of balance due.
Payment / Damages: Your balance must be paid in full upon check-in. There are no refunds for early departures for any reason. Guests may pay in cash but a credit card must provided for damages or other fees. You are responsible to pay for any damages caused by yourself, guest or visitor in your party. Any charges or fees unpaid upon check-out will be automatically charged to the credit card on file.
Keys: Please return your key to the drop-box by the front door. A fee of $50 will be charged for lost keys.
Quiet Hours: Quiet hours are from 10pm to 7am.Guests are not permitted to run generators in the campground.
Cleaning: Cabins are cleaned upon checkout. Additional supplies available upon request. Do not remove the towels from the room. You will be charged for replacement of any towels. If your room requires excessive cleaning beyond normal use it will be charged at a rate of $50 per hour. Shell Campground reserves the right to inspect the room at any time.
Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited in all indoor spaces and all porches/patios and will result in a fee of at least $250, plus the cost of any damages/repairs/cleaning and expulsion from the campground.
Pets: Most pets are allowed on property. Shell Campground reserves the right to refuse a pet at any time for any reason. For guests staying in cabins or glamping tents there is a pet fee of $20 per pet per night. Undisclosed pets will result in a fee of $75 per pet per night. There is no pet fee for guests staying in their own RVs or tents. Pets must be kept on a leash at all times and guests must pick up after their pet. Aggressive behavior from any guests pet(s) will not be tolerated and you may be asked to leave. You are financially responsible for any damage caused by any pet, including a visitors pet, in your party.
Grass: Do not drive or park on the grass for any reason, including parking your RV.
